review: Sol's round-161 request (Inspect and handle unfamiliar food: assess an owned gathered food unit by feasible examination, report observable condition, established food-use knowledge and uncertainty, and allow simple handling such as opening a shell when physically possible, without guaranteeing safety, removing toxins, creating food or awarding wellbeing) received the World Agent decision develop (learning 1): one general examine-and-mechanically-handle-food operation with an owned inputStackId, quantity of one whole unit, mode examine or open and optional toolIds/supportTargetId; examine at one round and 0.2 energy without material use; open at 0.5 energy per performed round under a physically validated resistance-and-force test; blocked attempts at no cost, paid failed trials, damage kept as progress, a conserved composition ledger, pause/resume/cancel/death semantics and no reward. The specification is self-consistent, so this is not a first release. Registry check first: the long-ex17 registry holds only the baseline interfaces (navigate, rest, wait, pickup, gather, eat, drop, give, message, request, learn, probe, consult, exchange, name, mark, tell, invite), plant-cultivation@1 and hearth-food-preparation@1. None opens a food unit: probe press/wet/heat consumes a 0.1 sample, consult only reads records, plant-cultivation inspects planting units and the hearth only heats roots or berries. The ex10 examine-food@1 and the ex13 hazelnut opening packages are outside this scope (the ex13 ones are bound to single specimens), so they stay unchanged and only their rules are reused as values. Implemented mechanical-food-handling@1 (scope long-ex17, ability mechanical-food-handling, handler long.mechanical-food-handling, export LONG_MECHANICAL_FOOD_HANDLING, file long-mechanical-food-handling.ts, events prefixed food-handling-, registered last in V7_PACKAGES; none of the package ids or file names reserved by other branches is used). examine (1 round, 0.2 energy, nothing used or reserved) writes a personal unverified record and emits food-handling-examination-started and food-handling-examined with: shape 'not represented', color, per-unit mass, firmness by touch, visible damage and crack progress, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration from the current decay share (of the interior only once exposed), the person's own eating record (memory.discoveries) when one exists, up to six personal records about that food with their keys, ticks and evidence event ids, and an explicit unknown list (shape, part masses, edibility and nutrition without an eating record, safety, toxins, interior condition while closed). It never reads hidden nutrition or toxicity and shows no edible or safe flag. open (1 round per performed attempt, 0.5 energy paid through workPay) reserves one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit through workReserve (it stays carried, owned and ageing) and performs one attempt per round; cancel (no energy) stops unfinished work. Resistance-and-force test from existing material values: strength = hardness/10 and flexibility/10 from openMaterial. A strike passes the load min(implement, support) of strength x (1 - flexibility). By the probe press law the food holds when its strength is not below that load: the trial is paid, food-handling-trial-failed is emitted, the unit returns unchanged and the work ends. Otherwise each strike adds damage (load - strength)/strength, kept on the unit: below 1 the outer layer is cracked and still closed and the unit stays reserved (food-handling-damaged; the operation continues or pauses); at accumulated damage 1 the outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed (food-handling-opened). Bare hands open only food of hardness at most 1 (the examine-food@1 rule that harder food needs a hard implement), at once in one paid round; hands never crack firmer food. In this world a gathered stone (0.8) on a stone rock opens a hazelnut (0.4) in one strike, an oak piece (0.7 x 0.8 = 0.56) needs three strikes, and a fallen-branch implement or support (0.3 x 0.8 = 0.24) holds. Blocked attempts (food-handling-blocked, no energy, no new job, a paused job stays paused): firm food by hand, a support without an implement, an implement without a support, more than one implement, a food, non-rigid (hardness below 1) or equipment implement, a support that is not a solid, unreserved object of a represented material or not in reach and view, and energy below 0.5. Identity and form errors (unknown, foreign, reserved, non-food, otherwise treated, already opened or fractional units) are refused before any cost. Progress: the job records method, implement, support, attempts and damage; the unit carries processing.foodHandling (parents, workId, outer cracked or split open, interior, damage, attempts, openedAt, openedBy and a ledger). An unworked round pauses without cost (food-handling-paused); open again resumes after rechecking unit, implement, support, reach and energy (food-handling-resumed) and keeps the job's implement and support unless new ones are named; cancel and death (onDeath; the unit is left on the ground where the person died, matching the existing death placement) release the unit once in its current state with no repair or refund (food-handling-cancelled); a unit that spoils while reserved stops the work. Only the owner can resume or cancel. Modeling assumptions: the load-transmission rule (the weakest or most flexible body in the load path limits the load); damage accumulation (load - strength)/strength with opening at 1, and immediate opening of zero-strength food; the hand threshold taken from examine-food@1; food flexibility is not used; one decay value for the whole unit, shown as exterior deterioration and as interior condition only once exposed (examine-food@1 classes below 0.25 and 0.65); the support's material is its data.resource; no tool wear, because under the existing contact law a body at least 0.5 harder takes none and no deformation law exists for a softer implement (the implement and rock are touched, not changed; contacts are counted on the job). Composition ledger: the world represents no shell or interior composition for any food, and the specification forbids inventing a shell mass from the label, so the parts stay together. The opened product is the same single unit (quantity 1, original mass, eating profile, origin, harvest date and decay, ordinary ageing); its ledger lists outer layer and interior with part masses not represented, 0 detached fragments and 0 losses. No extra edible unit, debris or resource is created; separating the interior from the shell into separate items is not implemented in this version. Eating keeps the unchanged eat rule (an opened unit eats exactly like an unopened one). Cracked or opened units carry a processing record, so plant-cultivation refuses them as treated. Experience: records are unverified (no information-confirmed), the practice evidence event carries no qualified flag (no milestone), and there is no satisfaction, wellbeing, comfort or nutrition change. Visuals: visualComponents is empty; events carry view metadata (operation, mode, actor, target and product ids, position, progress, outer and interior state, fragments 0, tool contact, outcome and uncertainty), and a product id appears only after the split commits. Reuse: open-physical.ts openMaterial; open-foundation.ts openRemember; collective-food-profile.ts (read only); forest-food-accounting.ts unit mass; forest-references.ts resolution; collective-work.ts escrow, paid work and stop; continuous-geometry.ts reach and visibility; the examine-food@1 hand rule and classes; the probe press law; and the ex17 plant-cultivation@1 and hearth-food-preparation@1 unit-inspection, paid-work and record patterns. No existing package is changed; hearth-food-preparation@1 and plant-cultivation@1 behavior and text are untouched. The ability serializes to 2932 code units (limit 3500). Tests cover scope, the text limit, vocabulary and one study round; examination cost, cited personal and eating records, the unverified record and no reward; blocked attempts that spend nothing and refused identities; one-strike opening with conservation, an unchanged implement and rock, unchanged ageing and eating, and the planting refusal; three-strike accumulation with pause, resume and the owner-only rule; paid failed trials for a weak implement and a weak support; cancel returning a cracked unit and a later attempt continuing from its damage; hand opening of a soft root splitting one unit off a stack; and death placement.
